Find the coverage shrink factor that matches two conditions

Source: R/downsample.R
optimize_shrink_factor.Rd

Search for the factor s in interval that minimises the two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic between the coverage of the target cells and s times the coverage of the reference cells, using stats::optimize(). The returned shrink_factor is round(optimum, digits) + offset and is meant to be used as the keep probability in downsample_fragments() for the reference samples.

Usage

optimize_shrink_factor(
  meta_data,
  group_col = "state",
  target = "ama",
  reference = "ctr",
  coverage_col = "coverage",
  interval = c(0.1, 1),
  digits = 2L,
  offset = 0,
  tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.25
)

Arguments

meta_data

A data.frame of cell metadata.

group_col

Column holding the condition labels.

target

Label of the condition whose coverage is kept (e.g. "ama").

reference

Label of the condition whose coverage is scaled (e.g. "ctr").

coverage_col

Numeric coverage column (e.g. from calculate_mapd()).

interval

Search interval for the factor, passed to stats::optimize().

digits

Rounding digits applied to the optimum.

offset

Number added after rounding; the default 0 returns the rounded optimum.

tol

Tolerance passed to stats::optimize() (its default).

Value

A list with optimum (unrounded minimiser), objective (KS statistic at the optimum) and shrink_factor (round(optimum, digits) + offset).

Examples

set.seed(1)
md <- data.frame(state = rep(c("ama", "ctr"), each = 300),
                 coverage = c(rlnorm(300, log(80), 0.3), rlnorm(300, log(240), 0.3)))
optimize_shrink_factor(md)
#> $optimum
#> [1] 0.3376999
#> 
#> $objective
#> [1] 0.04333333
#> 
#> $shrink_factor
#> [1] 0.34
#>
